ben_sales: Heads-up — large POC with FinServ client asking for a CAIQ dump + network diagram and a clear shared-responsibility table. They want answers by EOD Fri. Can security team take point on CAIQ responses? cc @maya

maya_security: On it. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) What deployment variants do they care about (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)? 2) Do they require BYOK or customer-managed keys for the POC?

ben_sales: They want all three variants documented (hosted/dedicated/private). For the POC they said BYOK might be a blocker but not mandatory — they'd like to know options. Also they asked about logging retention and who has access to raw request logs.

alex_engineering: Short summary for CAIQ entries: Hosted = Redwood-managed keys by default, Dedicated = option for customer-managed keys (BYOK) or Redwood-managed, Private = customer-managed KMS/HSM in their VPC/on-prem. We'll mark encryption controls as "shared" where appropriate. I can produce a one-page dataflow diagram showing where keys live and what we manage.

samir_se: Client PS/infosec also pressed on audit logs and access controls. For Dedicated/Private we can provide per-contract retention and access controls. Hosted has default 90d detailed logs, 365d available as an add-on. Need security to confirm wording for CAIQ.

maya_security: Confirming retention: Hosted default 90 days detailed request logs; 365d as paid retention. Dedicated/Private customers can configure retention per contract. Access to raw logs: Restricted to support/ops on a need-to-know basis; customers can request exports for Dedicated/Private. I'll put that into the CAIQ language.

ben_sales: Two deliverables for Thursday noon: 1) CAIQ-ready answers with explicit "shared responsibility" cells 2) architecture diagram for Hosted/Dedicated/Private showing KMS, traffic flow, and logging paths. Meeting with their InfoSec Friday 3pm — draft needed by Thu 12:00.

maya_security: :thumbsup: We'll prioritize. I'll start a CAIQ draft and tag owners for specific control groups.

alex_engineering: Adding a quick shared-resp snippet that we can paste into CAIQ responses:

```
Service          Hosted                 Dedicated                 Private
Encryption       Redwood (provider)     Shared (configurable)     Customer
Key Custody      Redwood (default)      Customer or Redwood       Customer (BYOK/HSM)
Logs Retention   90d (opt 365d)         per-contract              per-contract
Support Access   Limited (redacted)     Per-contract SLAs         Customer-controlled
```

maya_security: That table looks good. I'll expand it into per-control prose and reference the dataflow diagram Alex will supply. Assigning owners in tracker.

security-bot: Task created: SE-948 "CAIQ response + arch diagrams" assigned to maya_security, alex_engineering, samir_se. Due Thu 12:00.

ben_sales: Thanks — please ping here when drafts are uploaded. If anyone hits a blocker on legal wording for CAIQ assertions, loop in @legal.

samir_se: Will do. Also adding the client's specific CAIQ question IDs to the draft thread in #sales-docs once we have the mapping.

maya_security: Uploading first CAIQ draft to the shared drive shortly and will paste the answers here for review.

ben_sales: Awesome, appreciate it. :raised_hands:
